TranslationDelay.title: Translation and delay
TranslationDelay.queueHelp: A smaller queue keeps audio closer to live but may skip speech under load. Translation generation and delivery to listeners are not included.
TranslationDelay.frameHelp: 100 ms is the standard. Other sizes change how often audio is sent; their effect depends on speech and network conditions.
TranslationDelay.appliesLive: Applies during the broadcast to all languages.
TranslationDelay.conflict: Settings changed in another window. Load current settings before trying again.
TranslationDelay.partial: Some languages have not applied these settings. Retry to apply them.
TranslationDelay.languagePending: These settings have not been applied to this language.
TranslationDelay.fullDelayUnavailable: Full delay from the speaker is not currently measurable. A short audio queue does not mean the translation has caught up.
TranslationDelay.stale: Connection interrupted. Displayed values may be out of date.
TranslationDelay.serverTiming: Input packaging: {input} ms · Output publication: ≈{output} ms (server only)
